mission: Saxan under political pressure on Corellia; the book's first daylight glimpse of Lumiya (tasseled hem) passes through a Corellian checkpoint.
why_now: The Alliance operation's existence is leaking into Corellian political channels.
opening_hook: Saxan in her private office with Thrackan's representatives refusing her briefing requests.
conflict: Saxan's authority against Thrackan's shadow faction's obstruction.
turning_point: Saxan's aide, on the way out, passes a tasseled figure in a corridor — the reader's first daylight glimpse of Lumiya on Corellia.
closing_hook: The tasseled hem disappearing around a corridor corner; the aide not remarking on it.
setting: Corellian Prime Minister's office and adjacent corridors, Coronet City.
sensory_details: Office's polished desk; representatives' refusal of refreshment; tasseled hem moving out of frame.
emotional_trajectory: Political confrontation → political obstruction → uncanny peripheral glimpse.

stakes.interpersonal: Saxan's diminishing circle of trustworthy aides.
stakes.external: Lumiya's infiltration of the Corellian political apparatus.

canon_elements_needed: Lumiya's tasseled robe as signature visual
action_beats: Aide passes Lumiya in the corridor
notes: The book's first daylight Lumiya sighting.
